title: dracontomelon dao
intro: Dracontomelon dao, commonly known as the Daio tree, is a species of plant in the family Sapindaceae. This tropical tree is native to the Philippines and is valued for its medicinal properties, which include its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions due to its health benefits in reducing pain and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Dracontomelon dao are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Dracontomelon dao also contribute to its ability to modulate the immune system and protect against oxidative stress.
